free_tier.stated: No total storage quota stated; uploader accepts an unbounded number of files. Live uploader JS caps a single file at 155 GiB (constant MAXB = 155*1024*1024*1024, error string 'files over 150 GB are not allowed').
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: Extension blocklist is broad (php, html, js, exe, dll, apk, sh, py, xml, svg, iso-adjacent script types) — .bin/.parquet/.npy/.zip/.7z are fine. Retention: indefinite while accessed; only 45+ day untouched files are reclaim candidates.

egress.terms: Unmetered direct download links, no bandwidth product at all. No paid tier is sold, so there is no egress meter to trip.

tooling: chunked.php REST protocol, fully scriptable and keyless: POST ?action=init&filename=&size= -> {id, chunk_size}, POST ?action=chunk&id=&i= with raw body, POST ?action=finish&id= -> {url}. 128 MiB chunks, PARALLEL=6 in the shipped client.
chaining: Account-less upload breaks the per-account quota model entirely: every file is independent, so chain = unlimited files x 155 GiB. Only per-IP rate limits and the retention clock bind.
limits_note: 155 GiB / 150 GB per file (live JS constant). 128 MiB chunks, 6 parallel.
